metaDescription: Every EasyGoSpa therapist is trained and ID-verified. Choose your therapist from real profiles when you book, and see when they’ll arrive once they set off.
title: Trained, Verified Therapists Who Come to You
lead: Every EasyGoSpa therapist meets the same standard before they take a single booking.

trained.title: Professionally Trained
trained.role: Skilled in every treatment they offer
trained.text: Our therapists are trained in the treatments they offer, from gentle Swedish and aromatherapy to deep tissue, Thai stretching and hot stone.
trained.alt: Therapist Mia warming massage oil between her palms, the EasyGoSpa lotus on her chest

verified.title: Identity Verified
verified.text: Before their first booking, every therapist uploads an ID and takes a selfie that we match against it. When you book, you see their real photo and name.
verified.alt: Two steps of ID verification in the EasyGoSpa app: choosing the ID, then a selfie for the face match

arrival.title: Know When Your Therapist Arrives
arrival.role: Follow them from the moment they set off
arrival.text: Once your therapist sets off, the app shows how far away they are and roughly when they’ll arrive. After they accept, you can message them directly.
arrival.alt: The EasyGoSpa app booking progress screen: therapist Mia is on the way, with her arrival time, distance and a button to message her

rated.title: Rated After Every Visit
rated.text: After each massage you can rate your therapist. Ratings show on their profile, so the next client can choose with confidence.
rated.alt: Therapist Mia smiling warmly at the door

ctaText: When you book, you see each available therapist’s photo and profile and choose who comes to you.
